h1: 8 Best Hotels Near Keleti Station in Budapest (2026)
h1_main: 8 Best Hotels Near Keleti Station, Budapest
author_role: 8 hotels within half a mile of Keleti railway station compared on walking distance, price per night and guest scores
lead: Arriving at Keleti on a late train from Vienna, or leaving on an early one? Then the only thing that matters is how far you drag your bag. Two hotels here are on Baross tér, right across from the station (the best of them is IntercityHotel, the #1 pick, €69), and all 8 are within half a mile. Keleti is also on metro lines M2 and M4, so you are a few stops from the centre. This page gets you to the right one in under a minute.

I compared all 8 on what decides a station stay: the walk to Keleti, the price for the same night, guest scores, parking, and extras such as a spa or an apartment for groups, all from each hotel's live listing. Filter by walking distance, price or wellness below, or scroll straight to the ranking.

What the numbers say: staying by Keleti is cheap. Five of the eight cost €59–85, and the two closest (IntercityHotel and Baross, both on Baross tér) cost under €70. The best score is Onyx (9.0), a 0.4-mile walk.

• The best station hotel overall: #1 IntercityHotel.
  • The shortest walk: #2 Baross Hotel (164 ft).
  • The best-rated stay: #4 Onyx (9.0).
  • The cheapest bed: #5 Star Hotel (€59).
  • A pool after the train: #8 Lion's Garden.

Staying more than a night or two? Compare the areas in where to stay in Budapest; flying instead, see the airport hotels.

Metro to the centre: Keleti is on M2 (to Deák Ferenc tér and the Buda side) and M4 (to Kálvin tér and the Great Market Hall).

Baross tér at night: the square in front of the station is a busy transport hub; the hotels directly on it (IntercityHotel, Baross) are the shortest walk with luggage after dark.

Parking: Danubius Hungaria's garage has limited space and must be reserved in advance.

Airport: bus 100E runs from the airport to the city centre; from Deák Ferenc tér take M2 to Keleti.

faqs.q: What is the closest hotel to Keleti station?
faqs.a: Baross Hotel by Mellow Mood Hotels is 164 ft from Keleti, on Baross tér. IntercityHotel Budapest is on the same square.

faqs.q: What is the best hotel near Keleti station?
faqs.a: IntercityHotel Budapest is our #1: on Baross tér opposite the station, rated 8.9 from 5,530 reviews, with a garage, from €69 a night. Onyx Luxury has the highest score (9.0), 0.4 miles away.

faqs.q: Is it a good idea to stay near Keleti station?
faqs.a: It is practical for early or late trains and cheaper than the centre, and metro lines M2 and M4 take you to Deák Ferenc tér or Kálvin tér in a few stops. For a longer stay, District V–VII puts you closer to the sights.

faqs.q: What is the cheapest hotel near Keleti?
faqs.a: Star Hotel by Mellow Mood Hotels, from €59 a night for 2 adults on a March weeknight, 1,312 ft from Keleti.

faqs.q: Which hotel near Keleti has a pool?
faqs.a: Lion's Garden Hotel has a free spa area with a swimming pool, hot tub and sauna, 0.5 miles from Keleti near City Park.

faqs.q: How far is Keleti station from the city centre?
faqs.a: About 1.2 miles. Metro M2 from Keleti reaches Deák Ferenc tér, the main downtown interchange, in a few stops.

methodology: We searched Budapest hotels by distance from Keleti railway station and compared the best within half a mile on the walk to the station, the price for the same night (10 March 2027, 2 adults), the guest score and its sub-scores, parking and facilities, all from each hotel's live listing.
